sentences.en: Choose a song and transcribe the lyrics.
sentences.zh: 选择一首歌并抄写歌词。

sentences.en: Choose a song and transcribe the words.
sentences.zh: 选择一首歌并誊写歌词。

sentences.en: He spent hours transcribing his notes into a neat typed document.
sentences.zh: 他花了好几个小时把笔记打字整理成一份整洁的文档。

senses.zh: 抄写、誊写或用打字机打印; 把改录成另一种形式；把...译成文字；译; 用音标标出; 改编; 转录，复制
